answer: For epoch 123: standing grows only through vindicated dissent. When settlement later confirms a grader's minority call was right, that identity earns weight; lockstep majorities earn none. A sybil operator's clones, voting as one bloc, either follow the majority and gain nothing, or split against themselves so half are wrong by construction. Like water hollowing karst, real judgment cuts its own channel; a stand of timber cannot fake separate roots, and an opal fire cannot be copied by painting its surface. Independence becomes the scarce resource.
